**STEP 1 - Scene:** A tray meal with a quiche, roast chicken (sliced breast and a drumstick), a salad with beef strips and noodles, a chocolate bar, a glass of cola, and a jar of a light beige drink. The photo is oblique rather than strictly overhead.

**STEP 2 - Vessel:** Three paper plates on a tray: quiche plate ~18 cm, chicken plate ~18 cm, salad plate ~22 cm (area ~380 cm²). All items on the tray are treated as part of this meal.

**STEP 3 - Items:** Quiche, sliced chicken breast, chicken drumstick, mixed leaves with noodles, beef strips, chocolate bar, cola, beige drink.

**STEP 4 - Area:** Quiche ~35% of its plate, chicken ~40% and drumstick ~15% of their plate, salad ~70% of its plate. Drinks and the chocolate are not plate-based.

**STEP 5 - Volume:** Quiche ~133 cm² × 2.5 cm ≈ 330 ml. Chicken breast ~70 ml, drumstick ~90 ml. Salad ~266 cm² × 3 cm ≈ 800 ml (mostly air-filled leaves).

**STEP 6 - Grams:** Quiche 330 × 0.75 ≈ 250 g. Chicken breast ≈ 70 g. Drumstick ≈ 90 g. Salad leaves and noodles 110 g (leafy density applied). Beef strips ≈ 30 g. Chocolate bar ≈ 45 g. Cola ≈ 250 g. Beige drink ≈ 200 g.

**STEP 7 - Energy:** Quiche 250 g × 230 kcal/100 g ≈ 575 kcal. Breast 70 g × 165 ≈ 116 kcal. Drumstick 90 g × 200 ≈ 180 kcal. Salad 110 g × 45 ≈ 50 kcal. Beef 30 g × 200 ≈ 60 kcal. Chocolate 45 g × 540 ≈ 243 kcal. Cola 250 g × 42 ≈ 105 kcal. Beige drink 200 g × 60 ≈ 120 kcal.

**STEP 8 - Sanity check:** Total ≈ 1,045 g and ≈ 1,450 kcal. This is plausible for a full tray with a whole quiche, two chicken pieces, a large salad, a chocolate bar and two drinks. The quiche and drinks are the largest uncertainties.
